**Subject:** Meet Tanto – Your New AI Assistant for the Datacenter Team  

Hi Team,

I’m excited to introduce **Tanto**, our brand‑new AI assistant built specifically for the datacenter team.  
Tanto is powered by the Layer 8 platform and will help us work faster, smarter, and more reliably.

### What Tanto Can Do for You
- **Instant Data Access:** Query and retrieve records from our datacenter inventory (network devices, GPU servers, Kubernetes clusters, alarms, events, and polling targets) in seconds.  
- **Smart Updates:** Create, modify, or delete records directly from chat, with all actions respecting your existing permissions.  
- **Aggregated Insights:** Get quick summaries, counts, and totals (e.g., “How many GPUs are active?”, “Total uptime of all switches”), without pulling large data sets manually.  
- **Reporting & Export:** Generate CSV exports and custom text reports on‑the‑fly for audits, capacity planning, or incident reviews.  
- **Secure & Context‑Aware:** Operates within your permission scope, never exposing data you shouldn’t see, and always asks for explicit confirmation before any destructive action.

### Why This Matters
- **Speed:** Reduce the time spent navigating the Probler UI or writing ad‑hoc queries.  
- **Accuracy:** Get precise, up‑to‑date information straight from our source of truth.  
- **Collaboration:** Share generated reports and exports instantly with the team.  
- **Focus:** Let Tanto handle routine data look‑ups so you can concentrate on solving critical problems.

### Getting Started
- **Chat with Tanto:** Just type a natural‑language request (e.g., “Show me all network devices that are offline” or “Export a list of GPU servers with >{{int:64:96}} % utilization”).  
- **Ask for Help:** If you’re unsure how to phrase a request, ask Tanto for examples—he’ll guide you.  
- **Feedback:** We’ll continuously improve Tanto based on your input, so please share any suggestions or issues.

We’ll be rolling out Tanto to the datacenter Slack channel later today. Keep an eye out for the invitation, and feel free to start experimenting right away.

Welcome to a new era of data‑driven operations!

Best,  
[Your Name]  
Datacenter Operations Lead
